4.verdictExcerpt: **Status: REJECT** (due to the $O(N \times M)$ replacement logic which can be optimized to $O(N)$).

candidates.rawExcerptEndMarker: #### 2. Potential Leak of Temporary Directory on Success

candidate.title: Inefficient Text Replacement Complexity (O(N*M))
candidate.description: The `replaceUrlsInText` function iterates over all discovered attachments for every piece of text, and for each attachment, it performs two full-text regex replacements. If a PR has many images and long comments, this becomes $O(\text{attachments} \times \text{text length})$.
candidate.suggestion: Perform a single pass over the text using a regex and a lookup table (Map) to replace URLs with their corresponding placeholders.

candidates.rawExcerptAnchor: #### 2. Potential Leak of Temporary Directory on Success

candidate.title: Potential Leak of Temporary Directory on Success
candidate.description: While `cleanupAttachments` is provided in the return object, the responsibility for calling it is passed to the caller. If the caller fails to invoke this cleanup after moving the files to the final task directory, the `os.tmpdir()` will accumulate garbage.
candidate.suggestion: Ensure the higher-level orchestration (where `attachPrReviewImages` is called) has a guaranteed `try-finally` block to call `cleanupAttachments()`. (Note: This is a structural concern; verify the caller's implementation).
